Maya (Marketing Ops): Heads up — noticed inbound lead routing latency spike around 1725001100; a bunch landed in HS ‘Needs Review’ and some weren't assigned. Anyone else seeing this?
Jon (RevOps): yep metrics show mapping-service error burst at ~1725001087. Error = 503 upstream to the geo-inference lambda.
Hector (SDR): saw two leads appear directly in our backlog without owner — thought they were coming through fallback.
Riley (Growth): did a small HS enrichment change yesterday (utm parsing tweak) — could that affect mapping?
Jon (RevOps): unlikely. I dug into router logs: router config had route_unmapped_to='drop' for that deployment. Mapping cache warmed slowly after a restart and returned empty for a minute.
Maya (Marketing Ops): ok can we toggle to fallback? need to keep SDR queue warm.
Jon (RevOps): mitigation plan: 1) set route_unmapped_to='fallback_pool' temporarily; 2) invalidate mapping cache; 3) run backfill for leads created between 1725001060-1725001160. Will also gate reprocessing so enrichment_ts >= now()-3600.
deploy-bot: mapping-worker v3.2.1 restart scheduled by Jon at 1725001165 (ETA 45s).
Jon (RevOps): cache invalidated at 1725001180, router toggled at 1725001185.
Hector (SDR): SDRs notified — triage starting on fallback_pool.
Jon (RevOps): backfill kicked off. SQL to fetch affected leads: 
``
SELECT hs_id FROM hubspot_contacts WHERE created_at BETWEEN to_timestamp(1725001060) AND to_timestamp(1725001160) AND owner IS NULL;
```
Riley (Growth): pausing nurture emails for that cohort (will block by campaign tag).
Jon (RevOps): backfill complete at 1725001290 — 33 moved to fallback_pool, 9 directly assigned once mapping repopulated.
Maya (Marketing Ops): thanks. Action items: add mapping-health canary, add runbook for route_unmapped toggle, include a mitigation step in playbook to pause nurtures.
Jon (RevOps): will PR the canary and runbook update.
Hector (SDR): leaving a triage note in SDR handbook.
Maya (Marketing Ops): great work, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
